默认情况下，骨架屏会监听其内部的各个组件是否处于回调函数运算输出中状态，从而自动.en-us: By default, the skeleton monitors callback activity of its nested components and updates its loading state automatically.

设置参数`active=True`为骨架屏添加动态扫屏效果。.en-us: Set `active=True` to animate the skeleton with a shimmer effect.

对骨架屏中表达不同内容的部分进行灵活调整。.en-us: Adjust the skeleton placeholders for different types of content.

设置参数`listenPropsMode='exclude'`开启排除监听模式，.en-us: Set `listenPropsMode='exclude'` so the skeleton ignores updates to component properties listed in `excludeProps`.

设置参数`listenPropsMode='include'`开启包含监听模式，.en-us: Set `listenPropsMode='include'` so the skeleton monitors only component properties listed in `includeProps`.
